verdict.rationale: A built-in AI assistant is a fair question for a SaaS feature-management platform, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence documents an in-product assistant that users can delegate tasks to. The MCP server (docs-59, docs-60) requires an external AI client such as Cursor or Claude Code, so it is an adjacent integration rather than a built-in assistant and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
